variants.label: 12-night canonical plan
variants.notes: The checked-in itinerary is the immutable comparison baseline: Kefalonia 7 nights (car) then Lefkada 5 nights (car), open-jaw EFL in / PVK out, one direct Vasiliki-Fiskardo ferry, home by Jun 22 with Jun 23 held as a buffer before the Pittsburgh blackout.

sourceLocators.internal-itinerary: Kefalonia + Lefkada; variant canonical; open-jaw EFL/PVK; route-specific fares and 2027 ferry timetable require re-price

alternateNotes: A lower-risk routing variant flies round-trip into EFL (fully single-ticketable via Athens on Aegean) and reaches Lefkada by the same ferry in both directions, trading one extra ferry crossing and a little backtracking for avoiding the thin, charter-served, self-transfer PVK leg. It should be added as a formal variant only after its own fares and the second ferry day are reconciled; nights and budget are otherwise unchanged.
